notes.title: Updated on July 2, 2025:
notes.notes: [p]Updated on July 2, 2025:[/p][p]Add a skin image library to the Resource folder[/p][p]Skin component with background image, a total of 15 types and 122 colors, two styles, flat style and projection style, 7 skin textures[/p][p]32940 PNG images in total, with a capacity of 830MB[/p][p]Add 17 new sample music pieces[/p][p]Add 17 new universal dance scripts[/p][p]These scripts are suitable for most music and can be modified and optimized based on them[/p][p]New Projection Style Paper People Basic Intermediate Advanced Paper People[/p][p]7 new texture styles of paper figures have been added, including basic, intermediate, and advanced paper figures[/p][p]Interface and icon update optimization[/p][p]M key displays playback control bar, L key hides playback control bar[/p][p]Bug fixes[/p][p]The character translation function is unresponsive and has been fixed[/p][p]New paper person function malfunction, fixed[/p][p]Progressive dance function malfunction, fixed[/p][p]Skin scaling function malfunction, fixed[/p][p]Mixed dance weight parameters have no response, fixed[/p][p]Foot shadow position error, fixed[/p][p]Sometimes the joints flicker when adjusting the character's posture, which has been fixed[/p][p]End time not updated after loading music, fixed[/p]
